# HomeChat

> Control your home from WhatsApp. Lights, geyser, plugs and gates — start with one device today, add more when you're ready.

HomeChat lets you control your home from the WhatsApp you already use every day. A certified electrician installs a small smart controller (usually 1–2 hours), and from then on you turn things on and off, set schedules and see usage by simple chat — no new app to learn, no dashboard, no manual. Available in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Zambia.
